title: Nano Libris – Long-Term Human Readable Data Storage
content: Advancements in digital technology and data storage have brought challenges in the long-term preservation of archival data. Modern storage solutions like hard drives, magnetic tapes, and solid-state drives are effective for data retention. However, they are susceptible to failure over time and generate challenges from hardware degradation and software obsolescence, causing a potential danger of losing data permanently. This issue, often described as the “Digital Dark Age”, puts in danger the accessibility of archival records[1]. Therefore, it is essential to develop methods to secure data permanently and allow easy human access to the recorded information.
